name: Operations Overview
svgcontent:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="720" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
<rect id="BACKGROUND" x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#F4F7FA" stroke="#F4F7FA" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect id="HEADER" x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="105" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="TITLE" x="55" y="48" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="start">Nanomanufacturing Operations HMI</text>
<text id="SUBTITLE" x="55" y="79" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#D9EAF7" text-anchor="start">Live OPC-UA process monitoring and industrial security status</text>
<rect id="RECIPE_CARD" x="55" y="135" width="555" height="130" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="RECIPE_LABEL" x="85" y="175" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">ACTIVE RECIPE</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_RECIPE" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="30" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_RECIPE"  x="85" y="225" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="30" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">RCP-LITHO-001</text></g>
<rect id="PROCESS_CARD" x="670" y="135" width="555" height="130" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="PROCESS_LABEL" x="700" y="175" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">CURRENT PROCESS</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_PROCESS" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="30" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_PROCESS"  x="700" y="225" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="30" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">nanolithography</text></g>
<rect id="TEMP_CARD" x="55" y="300" width="350" height="165" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="TEMP_LABEL" x="85" y="342" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">TEMPERATURE SETPOINT</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_TEMPERATURE" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_TEMPERATURE"  x="85" y="397" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">##.##</text></g>
<text id="TEMP_LIMIT" x="85" y="438" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">Approved range: 20.00–25.00 °C</text>
<rect id="PRESSURE_CARD" x="465" y="300" width="350" height="165" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="PRESSURE_LABEL" x="495" y="342" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">PRESSURE SETPOINT</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_PRESSURE" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_PRESSURE"  x="495" y="397" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">##.##</text></g>
<text id="PRESSURE_LIMIT" x="495" y="438" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">Approved range: 0.90–1.10 bar</text>
<rect id="ETCH_CARD" x="875" y="300" width="350" height="165" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="ETCH_LABEL" x="905" y="342" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">ETCH TIME</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_ETCH_TIME" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_ETCH_TIME"  x="905" y="397" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" font-size="32" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">##.##</text></g>
<text id="ETCH_LIMIT" x="905" y="438" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">Approved range: 55–65 seconds</text>
<rect id="MACHINE_CARD" x="55" y="500" width="555" height="125" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#EAF8F0" stroke="#A7D7BC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="MACHINE_LABEL" x="85" y="540" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">MACHINE STATUS</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_MACHINE_STATUS" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#147D4A" stroke="#147D4A" font-size="29" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_MACHINE_STATUS"  x="85" y="588" fill="#147D4A" stroke="#147D4A" font-size="29" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">RUNNING</text></g>
<rect id="SECURITY_CARD" x="670" y="500" width="555" height="125" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#EAF8F0" stroke="#A7D7BC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="SECURITY_LABEL" x="700" y="540" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#486581" text-anchor="start">SECURITY STATE</text>
<g id="VAL_TOPIC127_SECURITY_STATE" type="svg-ext-value" fill="#147D4A" stroke="#147D4A" font-size="29" stroke-width="0" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" text-anchor="start"><text id="VAL_CHILD_TOPIC127_SECURITY_STATE"  x="700" y="588" fill="#147D4A" stroke="#147D4A" font-size="29" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">NORMAL</text></g>
<rect id="FOOTER" x="55" y="650" width="1170" height="45" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#D9EAF7" stroke="#B8D4E8" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="FOOTER_TEXT" x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#243B53" text-anchor="middle">Operator guidance: verify out-of-spec parameters before continuing manufacturing operations.</text>
<!-- TOPIC127_STATUS_LAMPS_START -->
<g id="GSE_TOPIC127_TEMPERATURE" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14"><ellipse id="GSE_CHILD_TOPIC127_TEMPERATURE"  cx="365" cy="332" rx="13" ry="13" fill="#A0AEC0" stroke="#486581" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<g id="GSE_TOPIC127_PRESSURE" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14"><ellipse id="GSE_CHILD_TOPIC127_PRESSURE"  cx="775" cy="332" rx="13" ry="13" fill="#A0AEC0" stroke="#486581" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<g id="GSE_TOPIC127_ETCH_TIME" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14"><ellipse id="GSE_CHILD_TOPIC127_ETCH_TIME"  cx="1185" cy="332" rx="13" ry="13" fill="#A0AEC0" stroke="#486581" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<!-- TOPIC127_STATUS_LAMPS_END -->
<!-- TOPIC127_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_LAMPS_START -->
<g id="GSE_TOPIC127_MACHINE_STATUS" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14"><ellipse id="GSE_CHILD_TOPIC127_MACHINE_STATUS"  cx="570" cy="560" rx="18" ry="18" fill="#A0AEC0" stroke="#486581" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<g id="GSE_TOPIC127_SECURITY_STATUS" type="svg-ext-gauge_semaphore" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14"><ellipse id="GSE_CHILD_TOPIC127_SECURITY_STATUS"  cx="1185" cy="560" rx="18" ry="18" fill="#A0AEC0" stroke="#486581" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<!-- TOPIC127_OPERATIONAL_STATUS_LAMPS_END -->
</svg>
